purpose: Train/val Events text-compression diagnostic: D2 (frozen rules, reference) vs E-Extract (LLM verbatim span selection) vs E-Summary (LLM per-event factual summary) under the same per-window Events token quota. No Aurora weights, no test-window text, no prediction.

scope.windows: manifest native.train / native.val only; composite key (var_key, sample_id); test/excluded keys used for exclusion checks ONLY
scope.debug_set: 19 windows: 1 train window per domain, domain-median by raw Events Aurora-token length (trace_D2.jsonl blocks.Events.raw_tokens, scope==train), lower-median index (n-1)//2, ties by composite key
scope.val_set: 57 windows: 3 val windows per domain = shortest / median / longest by the same length ordering, distinct, ties by composite key

llm_service.base_url_note: on theta via SSH tunnel: ssh -N -L 8020:localhost:8020 <user>@222.201.144.244; direct theta->zeta:8020 is refused
llm_service.route_discovery: probe GET /v1/models then /models; chat path is <prefix>/chat/completions; do not assume /v1
llm_service.api_key_note: read from env only; never in code, CLI, git, logs, or the audit pack
llm_service.seed_policy: if the service rejects seed, retry without it and record param_dropped; never switch models
llm_service.max_tokens_note: server-side cap for JSON+evidence; finish_reason=length is treated as truncated, never a complete output; Aurora budget is verified separately with the Aurora tokenizer
llm_service.determinism_note: temperature=0 is not strict determinism; all outputs cached in outputs/llm_cache.jsonl and reused; first rule-passing output is frozen

budget.E_definition: per-window Events token quota = trace_D2.jsonl blocks.Events.alloc (the frozen D2 allocation, base 270 incl. idle-budget recovery)
budget.overhead: enc('Events: ' + cleaned_head) + sum(enc('<k>')) for all events; pool = E - overhead
budget.per_event_rule: budget_k = pool//n, first (pool%n) events +1; single redistribution pass in original event order gives unused budget of short events to still-overlong events; deterministic from original lengths; shared by E-Extract and E-Summary
budget.fit_verbatim: event whose D2-cleaned full prose already fits budget_k is kept verbatim; no LLM call
budget.failure_policy: zero/negative budget with nonzero prose, unparseable events, or an event still failing after initial + 2 correction requests => event failure => the window's final candidate falls back to the frozen D2 input, counted separately; never truncate words/numbers/units/sentences to fake success
budget.hard_gate: token counts always via the in-package BertTokenizer on the final assembled string; prompt char caps are guidelines only
budget.assembly: 'Events: ' + head + concat(tag_k + ' ' + new_text_k) in original order; replacement prose = single leading space + stripped text (deterministic); other blocks reuse the frozen D2 kept_ids and allocs; freed budget goes to end padding only; content <= 510, total <= 512
budget.assembly_gate: Background/Calendar/Covariates token content must equal D2 bitwise at the recomputed (shifted) block boundaries; Events content = this scheme's generated text with actual length <= E; boundaries recomputed from actual lengths

prompts.hash_note: sha256 of each prompt file is recorded in outputs/run_manifest.json at compression time and enters the cache key

cache.key_fields: sha256(event_text) + method + str(event_budget) + prompt_sha + model + params_json + service_version(or null)
cache.reuse_rule: identical event text across windows reuses the same cached result; event_id is rebound to the current window's numbering at consumption; first rule-passing output frozen

qc.coverage_rule: coverage statistics are computed on the FINAL actual input (final ids/mask); windows that fell back to D2 contribute D2 coverage only, their unused extraction/summary results never count
qc.nonempty_metric: '>=3 tokens and not id-only/refusal' is a non-empty-fragment indicator only, never equated with fact coverage; fact fidelity requires original-text review
qc.fact_screening: regex screening (lowercased): numbers, ISO dates + month names, units, negation wording, forecast/plan wording; plus new-number detection (numbers in output absent from source) as hallucination screening; screening only, never a zero-hallucination claim

outputs_note: outputs/ is gitignored (LLM cache, attempts, bulk npz); results/ and the audit pack carry the full final products for all 76 windows x 3 schemes
